components.name: Legacy Pill (migrates later)
components.description: Legacy Apple-profile primary pill used by tiles below the rooms: #b8431f fill, white 400 label.

narrative.overview: One ordinary tiled Taiwanese building at dusk holds every enGo solution, and the light behind a window is enGo. The system is photographic rather than illustrated: a full-bleed 16:9 dusk photograph with orange dots on four windows, then paper-coloured rooms that open each floor as a larger photograph beside a short list. Colour is sampled from the photograph so interface and image read as one place. Type is Noto Sans TC set large, heavy at headline size and calm everywhere else.
keyCharacteristics: Photograph first: the hero stage keeps the photo's exact 16:9 ratio so window hotspots stay on their windows.
Dark dusk hero, warm terrazzo-paper rooms, grille-green accents; no white tile and no cool grey inside the world.
One action colour (enGo orange), one ink (#1e2a25), one muted ink (#4a5650).
Honesty is visual: every generated photo carries 示意圖; status is an outlined pill, 'in use' is a mint pill.
Motion is one authored moment plus scroll-driven depth, on transform and opacity, off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Sampled Colour Rule
rules.body: A colour enters the world only if it can be found in the photograph (sky, window, tile, terrazzo, grille) or is ink on paper. New hues need a photographic source.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: #c94f12 fills one primary action per surface and always carries a white label. Orange text on paper uses #b3460f. #f26b21 is light, not ink: it marks windows and bullets on dark grounds and is never set behind or as text.

rules.name: The Inherit Rule
rules.body: Global h1 to h6 carry color #1d1d1f, which would make headings vanish on dusk and green. Every heading in a world component sets color: inherit.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, label or counter sits above a heading. The role-and-product line sits beneath the room title. The breadcrumb is navigation, not a kicker.

rules.name: The Resting Surface Rule
rules.body: A shadow belongs only to a surface that sits on a photograph or paper (dot, label, desk, room photo). Flat rows, pills and bands carry none.

dos: Do set every world heading to color: inherit.
Do keep orange as one fill (#c94f12, white label) per surface and as link text only at #b3460f on paper.
Do put the 示意圖 label on every generated photograph, in its alt text and in a provenance sidecar.
Do show pilot, in-development and project-based states as outlined pills and in-use as the mint pill.
Do keep entry and scroll motion on transform and opacity, wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, with scroll-driven effects inside @supports (animation-timeline: view()).
Do place hotspots by percentage on the exact 16:9 stage.
Do keep every action at 44px or taller.
donts: Don't put a kicker, eyebrow, counter or caps label above a heading.
Don't use Window Light (#f26b21) as text or under white text.
Don't introduce a colour with no source in the photograph.
Don't let a generated photo ship without 示意圖.
Don't soften pilot, in-development or project-based states into an in-use look, or hide them.
Don't fill a section with Label Glass or a scrim; they exist to keep text legible on a photograph.

legacyLayer.note: Apple-profile layer (adopted 2026-10-18, PR #61) still governs sections below the rooms and all other pages; it migrates in later PRs. Tokens carry the legacy- prefix.
unresolvedConflicts: Two close oranges serve one action role: world #c94f12 / #b3460f versus legacy #b8431f / #9e391b.
The rooms' paper ground (#fbf8f2) is directly followed by the legacy parchment tile (#f5f5f7): two near-identical light grounds.
